entries.summary: Built a provisional GB home-energy AI-visibility panel from one public URL plus a one-line description: 18 sources, 7 ICP hypotheses (1 excluded from all cells), 6 buyer jobs, 46 canonical intent cells (33 unaided, 5 category-aided, 4 target-aided, 1 competitor-aided, 2 control), 72 candidate prompts, 70 accepted, 2 quarantined, 2 drafted-and-rejected.
entries.rationale: User supplied only URL and description, so the charter, competitor set, surfaces, budget and priorities are agent-assumed and the panel is labelled provisional_directional.

entries.summary: The aggregate counts block in prompt_qa.json v1.0.0 is wrong: it reads pass 65, quarantine 5, accepted 65. The per-candidate decision records and accepted_candidate_ids in the same file are authoritative and give pass 70, revise 0, quarantine 2 (prompt-017a, prompt-030a), rejected drafts 2, accepted 70. Three candidates (prompt-005a, prompt-008a, prompt-042b) are passes carrying open Gate 3 classification questions, not quarantines.
entries.rationale: Recorded rather than silently overwritten so the discrepancy is auditable. Correct the counts block in the next revision of prompt_qa.json before any freeze.

entries.summary: Blocking items before this panel can be called anything other than provisional: (1) all four human gates unapproved; (2) no variance pilot; (3) every sha256 field null because the runtime had no hashing tool; (4) cell-030 must be verified against a primary government source or deleted by 2026-08-15; (5) cell-007 must be restated when the 1 October 2026 cap period is published, due by 2026-08-26; (6) priority weights undefined by design.
entries.rationale: Every gate must be resumable from artifacts.

entries.summary: Three public-evidence conflicts resolved in favour of primary publishers: the 1 July 2026 price cap is GBP 1,663 per the regulator (source-004), not GBP 1,862 as some aggregators state; the target's Which? customer score is 79% per the publisher (source-007), not 74%; the target ranks 4th at 3.67/5 in the Citizens Advice Q1 2026 table (source-006) rather than first as aggregators assert. Counterevidence retained in source-016.
entries.rationale: Conflicting evidence is preserved rather than tidied away, and the resolution rule (primary publisher wins) is explicit.
